name: Stage 38: Lilla Uttervik to Västra Kovik
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 38, Lilla Uttervik to Västra Kovik.
utilities: Lilla Uttervik has start access and parking on the stage 37 approach about 200 m before the stage board; the exact parking pin is approximate and should be checked against local signs.

Västra Kovik/Koviksbadet is the main service cluster, with parking, beach, dry toilet, grill/fireplace, benches, bin, and rest/swim access confirmed by Naturkartan, Havs- och vattenmyndigheten, OSM, and Grillplatser.nu.

Public transport is weak. Naturkartan finds no nearby stops for stage 38 or Västra Koviksbadet; fixed bus stops are off-route and complementary traffic can be weekday/advance-booking dependent. Car, bike, taxi, or pickup planning is usually needed.
Nyköping C is the nearest practical train anchor, but it is far from both endpoints and should be shown as off-route context, not as ordinary trail access.
waterSources: Uttervik water-treatment tap at the official coordinate is the only verified year-round potable refill on the stage.
Västra Kovik/Koviksbadet has shore and bathing water only; do not treat the beach/waterfront as a drinking-water refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden, OSM tags, and the long-distance passport list stage 38 as 7 km. Naturkartan/AllTrails show about 6.8 km, OSM relation 3822242 measures about 6.70 km, Äventyrligare about 6.67 km, Trail Run Project about 6.0 km, and the local app GeoJSON measures about 6.06 km. Treat 7 km as the official planning distance and show the mapped-line caveat until the Gullängsberget/variant geometry is refreshed.

Main-route topology is continuous from stage 37 at Lilla Uttervik to stage 39 at Västra Kovik. For route-builder stitching, snap to OSM node 2789309812 at 58.622832,16.868308 and OSM node 2889603613 at 58.618465,16.938396; the official start marker remains nearby as trailhead context.

A shorter northern alternative around Gullängsberget is described by Sörmlandsleden for hikers who do not want the climb. The Gullängsberget loop, northern bypass, and Tunabergsrundan/coastal variants should be modeled as optional local routes only when their geometry is available.

Uttervik nature reserve rules include no damaging living or dead trees/shrubs, no collecting or damaging plants, fungi, or lichens except ordinary berries, edible mushrooms, and flowers for personal use, and no organized camp/activity or competition without permission. Follow posted signs for any additional restrictions.

No official shelter, designated campsite, or verified wind shelter was found on stage 38. Do not market it as an overnight stage; the next official shelter is Viggudden on stage 39, about 2 km after Västra Kovik.

Fires should be limited to confirmed prepared places, especially the grill/fireplace at Västra Kovik/Koviksbadet. Bring your own charcoal/wood, pack out waste, and check current Nyköping/Sörmlandskusten fire-ban status because stricter bans can also prohibit fixed grill-place use.
Länsstyrelsen notes bark-beetle damage in Uttervik reserve, so dead spruces may fall; avoid exposed forest sections in strong wind or heavy precipitation.

Gullängsberget has views, old grave/cairn context, calcareous flora, and nearby Bronze Age/stone-setting heritage. User reports describe the climb as short but technical/rocky and slippery or wet in places; stay on marked routes and do not disturb cultural remains or protected flora.

Local SPF and blog reports note that the cottage-road/stig continuation southeast of Lilla Uttervik can be tricky; watch orange markers carefully through Uttervik's cottage roads because the path-road transition is easy to miss.

The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass, but older maintainer/user reports show this corridor can be affected by blowdown and forestry debris, so check current trail status before relying on old GPX.

facilities.name: Uttervik reserve parking/access
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen reserve access parking/info-board context. Useful for Uttervik reserve access, but not the Lilla Uttervik stage endpoint.

facilities.name: Uttervik nature reserve rules
facilities.description: Reserve rule marker: do not damage living/dead wood or protected plants/fungi/lichens, and organized camps/activities require permission. Check signs locally.

facilities.name: Uttervik falling-tree caution
facilities.description: Länsstyrelsen notes spruce bark-beetle damage in Uttervik reserve; dead spruces may fall, especially in wind.

facilities.name: Stora Uttervik manganese mine
facilities.description: Mapped historic quarry/mining site in the Uttervik area. Treat as OSM/crowdsourced heritage context unless verified on site or in Fornsök.

facilities.name: Old quarry cluster near Lilla Uttervik
facilities.description: OSM-mapped former quarry cluster, including water-filled pits near the early stage corridor. Treat as hazard/context only, not as a water source; stay on marked trail.

facilities.name: Water-filled former quarry
facilities.description: Former quarry/water-filled pit from OSM research. Not a potable-water source; avoid edges and supervise children/dogs.

facilities.name: Gullängsberget western viewpoint
facilities.description: Mapped viewpoint on/near the Gullängsberget climb. The climb is short but technical/rocky and can be slippery when wet.

facilities.name: Gullängsberget viewpoint and ancient grave
facilities.description: OSM peak/viewpoint and heritage context near Gullängsberget; official text highlights views and an ancient grave/cairn. Exact trail-side heritage pin should be field-verified.

facilities.name: Gullängsberget stone-setting area
facilities.description: Bronze Age/ancient-remains context from OSM and local walk reports near the Gullängsberget approach. Do not disturb stones, cairns, graves, or signs.

facilities.name: Gullängsberget loop option

facilities.name: Northern Gullängsberget shortcut

facilities.name: Mörkviken swimming/rest context

facilities.name: Västra Kovik / stage 39 junction

facilities.name: Västra Kovik beach
facilities.description: Municipal bathing-place cluster maintained locally; useful for swimming/rest but not a potable-water source. 2025 samples were serviceable and the 2026 classification is excellent, but check current-season samples and algae status before swimming.

facilities.name: Västra Kovik dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at/near the beach, supported by OSM, Naturkartan, and Havs- och vattenmyndigheten context.

facilities.name: Badplats Kovik grill place
facilities.description: Beach grill/rest area with dry toilet, bin, benches, view, beach access, and wheelchair-friendly context listed by Naturkartan/Grillplatser and corroborated by local reports. Bring charcoal/wood, pack out waste, and check fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Västra Kovik parking
facilities.description: Parking at the beach/end cluster; check local signs, especially for longer stays.
